headline: SingPost H1 Profit Jumps 183.7% on Shophouse Sale and Leaseback
summary: Singapore Post reported an 183.7% increase in first-half net profit to $55.9 million, bolstered by the sale and leaseback of HDB shophouses, even as revenue slipped 1.3% to $185.9 million.
why: Asset monetization strategies can significantly boost reported net income for logistics and postal companies experiencing top-line core revenue declines.

impacts.name: Singapore Post Ltd
impacts.why: First-half profit rose 183.7% due to property transactions.
